fields.description:
As a dispatcher I want to search and filter the aircraft list so that I can quickly locate specific aircraft.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The search field accepts text input and filters results in real time.
2. The filter panel allows filtering by aircraft type, status, and base location.
3. When no results match the filter criteria, an empty state message is displayed.
4. Clearing all filters restores the full aircraft list.

Out of Scope:
Bulk operations on filtered results are not in scope for this story.

Specified Behavior:
The search operates on the aircraft registration number and aircraft name fields only. Other fields are not included in the search index.

Dependencies:
Requires the aircraft reference catalog to be populated (see TEST-FMT-002).
